name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Solve MaxCut on the graph
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Solve MaxCut on the graph [(0, 1), (0, 3), (0, 4), (1, 3), (2, 3)] with QAOA (p=1) in PennyLane: build cost/mixer layers manually, optimize with AdamOptimizer, and print the most probable bitstring and its cut value. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
